### Problem
The `Panel` function (`upstream.go:514`) is the non-streaming/non-progressive fusion path. It has exactly **one** `slog.Info` call — the arbiter cache hit at line 599. There is zero logging for: which panel member succeeded/failed, when the arbiter was invoked (non-cache-hit path), when the arbiter returned empty synthesis, when a panel goroutine panicked (IncPanelPanics is called but not slogged). This makes production debugging of the non-progressive fusion path effectively impossible — operators must enable debug-level HTTP trace logging to understand what happened.

### Proposed solution
Add slog calls to the `Panel` function at each meaningful branch:
1. Panel members completed — `slog.Info("fusion panel: members ready", ...)`
2. Arbiter invoked (cache miss) — `slog.Info("fusion arbiter invoked", ...)`
3. Arbiter returned empty synthesis — `slog.Warn("fusion arbiter returned empty synthesis", ...)`
4. Panel goroutine panic (already calls `IncPanelPanics()`, add slog before it)
